objective: Reducir el cobro múltiple de N deudas de N POST secuenciales a un solo round-trip HTTP y una sola transacción D1, manteniendo un operation_id y receipt payment.create por deuda.
owner_authorization: El owner probó en Android un cobro múltiple de 14 deudas y reportó ~30 segundos en Procesando; pidió aplicar un enfoque de primeros principios para eliminar el cuello de botella.
invariants: Every debt remains an immutable canonical financial operation whose stored command is payment.create.
Every debt keeps a unique child operation_id and an independently replayable receipt.
The browser sends one POST /commands/payment.batch for a multi-debt payment instead of N sequential payment.create POSTs.
The Worker validates authority and every expected_credit_revision inside the same D1 transaction before success becomes visible.
A rejected child aborts the entire new batch; the first attempt cannot partially commit.
Lost ACK retry replays the exact same batch payload and child operation_ids.
Cash payments still require an OPEN canonical cash session; digital reference behavior remains unchanged.
No optimistic success before a durable Worker receipt.
Exactly one background canonical reconciliation remains after the confirmed batch.
rollback: Deploy the prior production Worker and revert the feature PR. No schema rollback is required.
